Grizzwerks Defense Industries is a commercial organization specializing into the defense contracting business. It is managed by the goblin Grizzby of the Steamwheedle Cartel. During the events of , Grizzek could be found in the harbor town of Ratchet, where he had the adventurers help him acquire some supplies and sign contracts with commanders from the Horde and Alliance in exchange for some premium gear from his catalog. Thanks to the efforts of adventurers across Azeroth, the business eventually achieved record growth, and Grizzby offered runes to the heroes, this time without requiring quests from them.

Gundargaz is the quest hub and largest settlement of the Ringing Deeps, found in the west-central part of the zone. It also serves as the Assembly of the Deeps renown headquarters. Players are initially directed here during Pomp and Dire Circumstance early in the Ringing Deeps storyline. The area is bordered by Ironhaul Station to the west, the Hallowfall Gate to the northwest, the Earthenworks to the north, the Lost Mines to the east, Brunwin's Terrace to the east and south, and the Waterworks and Shimmermist Falls to the southwest.

The Halfhill EDM Track, or EDM Kazoo Remix, is a modified track of the original "Stormstout Brew" song composed by Edo Guidotti from the Mists of Pandaria Soundtrack, also known as the "Kazoo" Inn song. It was published on X/Twitter and later published on YouTube as a 32 minute-long video on 5 August 2024. * * *

The Hall of Fame guild achievements are awarded to the first 200 guilds to defeat the final boss of a new raid on Mythic difficulty. These achievements recognize top-tier raiding guilds and grant exclusive titles to players who earn them. For example, in , the Hall of Fame: Chrome King Gallywix achievement requires defeating the last three bosses of the Liberation of Undermine raid on Mythic difficulty. The title granted for this achievement is the "Famed Slayer of The Chrome King".

The Hal'hadar are a group of ethereals originally serving as Nexus-King Salhadaar's research division, operating as artificers, weapon technomancers, and sometimes as assassins, in contrast to the Shadowguard who served as his military. Although rarely seen, the Army of the Light have encountered the Hal'hadar before, though they usually skirmished with the Shadowguard. Even members of the Shadowguard rarely encountered them according to Veraan, as their missions were usually kept secret to the Shadowguard, and the only ones who did were those with high enough clearance to be called in as security for their operations.
